data.one_liner: A toast and snackbar package for rich interactions like slide to dismiss and stacked animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable toastbar widget that can be triggered imperatively via a context. Features include slide-to-dismiss, auto-dismiss, dismiss-on-demand through action buttons, and stacked animations.
use_when: You want to display rich, interactive toast notifications or snackbars.
You need features like slide-to-dismiss or stacked toast notifications.
avoid_when: You require system-level push notifications or local OS notifications.
You need a state management library.
strengths: Includes features like slide to dismiss and auto dismiss.
Easy integration with standard Flutter button callbacks.
